headline: Income in Madre de Dios grew 40%, but human development did not move. Did illegal mining lurk behind it?
summary: Income in Peru's Madre de Dios region grew 40%, but human development did not move, Gestión reports. Satellite images show faster deforestation linked to illegal mining this year.
why: Illegal mining affects regional economies, environmental permits and the legal framework governing small-scale gold mining in Peru.
